item.title: VIDEO: ICE agents pepper-spray Ohio mom, 3 kids inside moving vehicle
item.description: A mom wants two ICE agents investigated after they deployed pepper spray into her open car window, hitting her and three children.

item.title: I-Team: First look at new plans for Browns dome complex
item.description: The Fox 8 I-Team has obtained new plans for a Browns dome.

item.title: Astronaut speaks out after medical condition prompted space station evacuation
item.description: NASA’s Mike Fincke identified himself Wednesday as the astronaut whose medical condition prompted the space agency’s first medical evacuation.

item.title: Digital signs will soon offer real-time weather alerts in Northeast Ohio
item.description: State and federal officials announced an expansion of a real-time weather alert system Wednesday designed to warn Northeast Ohio drivers of dangerous conditions.

item.title: Memo reveals gaps in Cleveland school bus safety: I-Team
item.description: The FOX 8 I-Team has found the Cleveland Metropolitan School District (CMSD) accused of failing to take basic steps aimed at keeping students safe on buses.

item.title: Short-handed Cavaliers fall to Bucks 118-116
item.description: Kevin Porter Jr. had 20 points, Ryan Rollins added 18 and the Milwaukee Bucks held off the short-handed Cleveland Cavaliers 118-116 on Wednesday night for their fifth victory in six games.

item.title: 8 key signs it might be a scam: Scam Squad
item.description: Teaching people what the fraudsters are doing so that they can avoid becoming victims to begin with is a critical part of what the agencies are doing.

item.title: FORECAST: When to expect milder temps and sunshine
item.description: Not as gusty tonight as a cold front continues to move out of the region. Temperatures cooling down into the 20s and teens behind the front. A quiet night with partly cloudy skies.

item.title: FBI warns against pointing lasers at aircraft after reports across US, including in Ohio
item.description: The FBI is issuing a warning about the danger of pointing lasers at aircraft, amid newly released statistics that show more than 10,000 laser strikes were reported by pilots across the U.S. in 2025.

item.title: Dust to dust: Ohio Senate Bill 323 allows human composting after death
item.description: A new Ohio Senate bill would authorize natural organic reduction for humans after death -- also called human composting -- a process through which human remains are naturally converted into soil.
